intake: Original 36 qualified configurations from iteration_03; EX28 parameter probes are diagnostic evidence, not an automatically expanded contender set.
selection_disclosure: Successor method approved after seeing previous results. Baseline precision is inherited from iteration_03. New diagnostic precision and conventions are fixed in this file before this build; this is not blind validation.

original_goals.return: CAGR >= 1.5 * same-scenario buyhold CAGR; if buyhold <= 0, strategy > 0 and > buyhold
original_goals.drawdown: Drawdown magnitude strictly smaller than same-scenario buyhold

parameter_scope: EX28 fixed 16-position six-parameter joint design, equal position weights; holding period fixed at2. Other modules remain auxiliary and are not pooled.
statistical_policy: Reuse original configuration bootstrap and original-family PBO/DSR with hashes and explicit scope. Append EX28 184 standard evaluations plus184 cost stresses to the historical ledger; do not claim old PBO/DSR covers the expanded history.
